articles.title: BlackRock, Fidelity, other Wall Street giants back the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs and SoFi have publicly endorsed the crypto market structure bill as the Senate's timeline tightens.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops as South Korean stocks tumble, Senate shelves crypto Clarity Act
articles.snippet: BTC shed 2% as South Korea's Kospi plunged 11% and the U.S. Senate shelved the Clarity Act, leaving the market facing a pivotal Fed decision on Wednesday.

articles.title: U.S. Senate puts off crypto Clarity Act for now as it focuses limited bandwidth elsewhere
articles.snippet: The majority leader is pursuing floor time for unrelated bills as the crypto industry waits for its policy effort to get its chance for votes.

articles.title: Cross River to enable P2P payments, banking services for X Money
articles.snippet: The banking-as-a-service provider will power X Money’s peer-to-peer payments, FDIC-insured accounts and Visa debit cards as the platform expands its financial services.

articles.title: XRP Price Slides as Senate Drops Clarity Act and Fed Decision Looms
articles.snippet: The Senate kicked the can, the Fed has traders on edge, and XRP's charts are running out of support zones to fall back on.
